failed_conditions.quote: image_geometry/cameramodels.py uses deprecated `numpy.matrix` subclass causing runtime `PendingDeprecationWarning`.

loudness.quote: Warning: the matrix subclass is not the recommended way to represent matrices or deal with linear algebra (see https://docs.scipy.org/doc/numpy/user/numpy-for-matlab-users.html). Please adjust your code to use regular ndarray.

resolution.quote: The original issue has been fixed with https://github.com/ros-perception/vision_opencv/pull/527.

notes: Verified against vision_opencv issue #524 and PRs #526/#527. The deprecation of numpy.matrix produces a PendingDeprecationWarning on runtime invocation.
